captions.detailed: A historical-style siege mortar featuring a short, wide-bore bronze barrel resting on two dark metal trunnions. The barrel is supported by a low, dark brown wooden trestle bed with four blocky corner feet instead of wheels. A dark wooden elevation wedge is positioned underneath the breech to adjust the barrel's tilt, allowing the barrel to rotate relative to the main carriage.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a historical siege mortar with a short, wide-bore bronze barrel mounted on a wooden trestle carriage. The barrel should tilt via side trunnions, and include a sliding wedge underneath the breech for elevation control.
captions.factory: Construct a base trestle carriage using box primitives for the side rails, crossbeams, and four blocky corner feet. Create the short, wide-bore barrel using a revolved profile or a combination of cylinders with a hollowed-out top. Add cylindrical trunnion pins on the sides of the barrel, resting in cradles on the side plates. Finally, model a trapezoidal wedge block positioned beneath the rear of the barrel to act as the elevation adjustment mechanism.
